cards.title: Familiar Tune
cards.body: It’s frustrating when you’ve done the healing, the introspection, and then boom—you’re in a new relationship that feels uncannily like the old one. Different face, same familiar ache. That’s not a cosmic joke; it’s a subconscious pattern playing out. The real work isn't finding different people, but rewriting your own script. What pattern feels like your personal broken record?
cards.caption:
The hardest patterns to break are the ones we don't realize we're setting. What's a pattern you've quietly recognized in your own journey?

video_reels.title: Still You
video_reels.line: Catching them doing that small, everyday thing – humming while they cook, remembering your coffee order, or making you laugh when you really needed it – and just feeling that quiet, grateful rush of 'Yep, still them. Still my favorite.'
video_reels.caption:
